chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Flax (linen) is from the clothing of the Prophets, and it builds the flesh.'

key_terms.الكتان: Flax/linen — the plant Linum usitatissimum, whose fibers are used to make linen cloth
key_terms.لباس الأنبياء: The clothing of the Prophets — a formula indicating prophetic precedent and recommendation
key_terms.ينبت اللحم: Builds/grows the flesh — a traditional medicine claim that linen promotes bodily health and tissue growth

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq say about wearing linen (flax) clothing?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) recommends linen (flax fabric) as a garment, noting that it was the traditional clothing of the Prophets and that it has the physical benefit of promoting growth and strengthening of bodily flesh. This hadith is part of a chapter on the virtues of specific fabrics, reflecting the Imami tradition of linking material practices to prophetic precedent. In the context of early Islamic jurisprudence, recommending the clothing of the Prophets carried both spiritual and normative weight, encouraging believers to emulate the Prophets in their daily attire.
